name: Head Vampire
description: A captivating undead dressed in aristocratic finery.

abilities.name: Terrifying
abilities.description: When the Vampire makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

abilities.name: Look into My Eyes
abilities.description: A creature who moves into Melee range of the Vampire must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, you gain 1d4 Fear.

abilities.name: Feed on Followers
abilities.description: When the Vampire is within Melee range of an ally, they can cause the ally to mark a HP. The Vampire then clears a HP.

abilities.name: The Hunt Is On
abilities.description: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Vampires, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

abilities.name: Lifesuck
abilities.description: When the Vampire is spotlighted, roll a d8. On a result of 6 or higher, all targets within Very Close range must mark a HP.
